voice:
This is a measuring drill, Sissy.
You will stand beside someone in your imagination... rank yourself honestly... and let the number be recorded, so the training always knows where you are.
There is no wrong answer here... only an honest one and a flattering one. Bring me the honest one. Sissies like you get more from the truth than from the flattery... the truth moves.
Get comfortable and let the pictures come easily... this drill runs entirely on imagery. Nothing outside you changes while you do this... the work happens in your own sweet head, where it is safe. Let your eyes soften and your shoulders drop... comparisons land best through relaxed eyes. Settle in, sweet girl... stillness makes the mirror sharp. Wherever you are, own the space for a few minutes... a measuring girl deserves a steady room. Warm hands, loose jaw, quiet face... your body calm is how the images come clear. Every number you give today becomes a bookmark... future sessions will find you by it. Honesty first, Sissy... flattery is a friend this drill refuses to invite.
Picture her, then... a real girl.
The kind who was never asked to become... she simply woke up hers. Hair falling where it falls... hips that take up space like the space was always reserved... a laugh with no rehearsal in it.
Look at her properly, Sissy. The ease... the effortlessness... the way the world reads her at a glance and asks for nothing more.
And now feel yourself standing in her shadow... close enough to see the stitching of the life you want.
And that pull you feel toward her... the wanting to be more like that... give that a number too.
Sissies like you look up at real girls... and looking up is a compass bearing. It points somewhere, and the somewhere is you, later. Sissies like you rank below her and love it down there... the view from beneath the effortlessly feminine is the sweetest view there is. Sissies like you borrow her as a north star... every point of distance becomes direction. Sissies like you ache a little beside her... and the ache is the growing edge of you, tender because it is alive. Sissies like you know the gap is a garden... something gets planted in you every time you measure it. Sissies like you carry her image like a key... it unlocks the wanting that does the training. Sissies like you admire without bitterness... envy refined, Sissy, is called aspiration. Sissies like you drift closer every session... the number moves because you move. Sissies like you become the kind of girl other girls inspire... that is a beautiful way to grow. Sissies like you thank her, silently, every time... for showing you the shape of the possible.
Whatever number you gave... it is a coordinate, and coordinates exist to be moved. Every drill, every session, every line spoken out loud moves it. That rank is alive, Sissy... and so are you.
A different mirror now, Sissy... picture a sissy further along her path than you.
Prettier in her training... softer in her walk... maybe locked, maybe owned, definitely deep in it. Someone whose progress you have watched with your pulse in your throat.
See her clearly... the confidence of a girl with miles on her... the way she wears the same word you wear, Sissy, like it was tailored.
And feel where you stand on that road, relative to her.
The sight of her, further along... name what it stirs.
Sissies like you climb on their knees... every step down is a step along, and the road rewards the posture. Sissies like you read her progress as a map... someone walked it, so the road is real, so the road goes somewhere. Sissies like you cheer for the girls ahead of them... her wins prove the wins exist, and that is wonderful news. Sissies like you are all on one road, spread out like beads on a string... the string is what matters, and you are strung on it tight. Sissies like you envy beautifully... envy pointed forward, Sissy, has another name: ambition. Sissies like you measure against their sisters and find belonging... the ranking is a family portrait. Sissies like you remember she once stood exactly where you stand... and she made it, so the making works. Sissies like you compete sweetly... the prize is everyone rising, and everyone includes you. Sissies like you wear their rank like a hem length... it shows where you are, and hems rise. Sissies like you turn the whole hierarchy into a ladder... and ladders, sweet girl, are for climbing.
Your rank among your sisters moves the way all of ours do... slowly, then suddenly. Training, dressing, serving, obeying... and one day a newer Sissy measures herself against you. Be worth measuring.
The hardest mirror last, sweet girl... picture him. Who you were before.
The boy-shaped life... the swallowed wanting... all that pretending he called normal and you called Tuesday.
See him honestly, Sissy... the heavy walk, the averted eyes, the hunger he kept feeding with crumbs and calling it a meal.
Feel the distance between where he stood and where you stand... and rank what you see.
And the view from here, looking back at him... put a number on that too.
Sissies like you thank him for keeping the seat warm... he held the life until she arrived to claim it. Sissies like you outrank him by existing... honesty itself scores higher than pretending ever did. Sissies like you were chrysalises... him the shell, you the wings... the ranking writes itself. Sissies like you measure backward and shiver sweetly... look how far. Look how far. Sissies like you let the old rank fall like a hem... it did its job, and it is done. Sissies like you keep him as a before-picture... progress needs a place to stand to be seen. Sissies like you forgive him his hiding... he knew, even when he kept it quiet. Sissies like you draw the old self like a baseline on a chart... every day lifts the line. Sissies like you know the comparison that matters is the one across time... and time is on your side, Sissy. Sissies like you promise him it was worth it... and keep the promise with every step.
That distance... you built it. Every honest yes, every ounce of practice, every wave of this training... and the distance is still growing. He is the floor, Sissy, and you have already left the ground.
Whichever mirror you chose, the finding is the same finding... you are on a path with a direction, standing at a number that moves.
Sissies like you measure themselves and smile... because a number is only scary when it is finished, and yours is still being written.
Low rank beside a real girl? Then the direction is set, and the walking is the sweet part. Mid-pack among your sisters? Then you can see both ends of the road... and the view from the middle is motivation on a plate. Miles above your old self? Then the evidence is in, Sissy... the transformation works, and it is working on you. Whatever your numbers said, they went in the record... and the record now knows exactly how to aim at you. The ranking girl is the growing girl... a Sissy who measures is a Sissy who cares, and caring is the engine. Next session, the numbers get compared... and Sissies like you love a scoreboard they are winning. Every point of distance you found is a place the training will visit... consider your honesty a map with pins in it. You looked, you ranked, you stayed... that is courage wearing lace, and it deserves reward.
Good Girl.
Measured, recorded, and more motivated than when you pressed play... that is what this drill does. Carry the numbers lightly, Sissy... they exist to move, and you exist to move them.
